messages:
Alyssa: quick check — planning to flip the per-tenant routing toggle for eu-us split tomorrow 05:30 PT (quiet window). Can someone take ownership of the flip and run the smoke plan? safe defaults are set to `route_fallback: true` and `max_tenants_per_instance: 50`.
Ben: I can take the flip if Carlos is on rollback readiness.
Carlos: I can be on rollback. what percentage are we starting at? tiny traffic or 10%?
Alyssa: start with tiny traffic (1%) for 10 minutes, then 5%, then 20% over the next 30m. staged: 1 -> 5 -> 20. if any error > 0.5% on 5xx or latency p50 > 300ms, abort and rollback.
Irene: pinging devex for runbook link + smoke checklist. also leaving a quick CR note: small change in flag conditioning landed in PR #4129 — @Ben please ensure the canary build includes that commit.
sre-bot: deploy-checklist: preflight ok, no infra incidents, capacity check ok.
Ben: CR verified, commit included. I'll run the flip. plan: flip 1% at 05:30, wait 10m, run smoke.sh, push to 5% if green.
Carlos: rollback plan: set toggle back to safe default (explicit `route_fallback: true`) and trigger `sync-config --target=all` to ensure old routing restored. If config rollback fails, scale up standby pool and redirect traffic to the fallback region.
Alyssa: smoke steps: 1) run `./scripts/smoke.sh --tenant sample-tenant-42` 2) verify traces in tracing.redwood (search tag `toggle_rollout=morning-slice`) 3) check token-level cost and error rates in console for affected models.
Ben: adding commands here: ```
# flip to 1%
redwoodctl feature set per_tenant_routing --pct 1 --note "morning-slice"
# smoke
./scripts/smoke.sh --tenant sample-tenant-42 --expect-200
```
Irene: I'll be monitoring dashboards during the window. I'll also keep an eye on the A/B regression evals — if quality drop > 1.5 BLEU relative to baseline, we halt.
Carlos: agree. alert thresholds where to send page? set to #eng-oncall and paging policy on call rotation.
Alyssa: yes page #eng-oncall and DM Ben/Carlos. Ben — can you post the exact times once scheduled in the calendar?
Ben: scheduled and shared the calendar invite. title: "per-tenant routing morning slice — flip ownership: Ben
Carlos (rollback)". I'll post the runbook URL in the thread 10m before flip.
Irene: quick question — any tenant-specific safe-default overrides we should pre-seed? e.g., vip tenants pinned to old route?
Alyssa: good call — vip tenants are pinned (see config key `tenant_overrides.vip=true`). I've exported the list to S3: s3://redwood-configs/morning-slice/vip-list.csv. Ben, please confirm the flip excludes that file.
Ben: confirmed, flip excludes vip-list.csv.
Carlos: last check — who has permission to revert the flag if something weird happens? need someone with org-admin toggle rights.
Alyssa: Ben has rights for that toggle, Carlos has temporary escalation rights (I opened a short-lived grant).
Ben: ack. I'll do the flip and run the smoke. posting runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/per-tenant-routing-morning-slice
Irene: I'll watch dashboards and run the regression evals. If anything looks off I'll call for rollback.
Ben: 05:30 PT tomorrow. owners: Ben (flip), Carlos (rollback), Irene (dashboards). thanks all :thumbsup:
